name: login-page
title: Login page
description: Split-screen sign-in: brand gradient panel with a glass testimonial, and an email/password form.

name: dashboard-page
title: Dashboard
description: Customer-service dashboard: sidebar, date-range filter, stat cards, and a cases table with channel filter and row actions.

name: mobile-app-page
title: Mobile app shell
description: Mobile web / PWA shell: glass top bar, segmented filter, chat list, bottom tab bar and a compose drawer.

name: landing-page
title: Landing page
description: Marketing page: glass navbar, animated hero, logo marquee, feature cards with spotlight, stats and a call to action.

name: console-page
title: Contact center console
description: Agent console: collapsible sidebar, searchable chat list with filters and unread counts, the conversation, and a case panel with SLA countdown, tags and activity. List and chat switch views on phones.

name: register-page
title: Thai sign-up
description: Four-step sign-up: account, Thai citizen ID (check digit), phone with SMS code, and Thai address with postal-code lookup, then a summary.
